code:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']
  - job_name: node
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['node-exporter:9100']
  - job_name: app
    metrics_path: /metrics
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['{{app_target}}']
